medicines.dosage: Adults: 1-2 tablets every 4-6 hours as needed. Maximum 8 tablets in 24 hours.
medicines.uses: Relief of mild to moderate pain (headache, migraine, toothache) and reduction of fever.
medicines.contraindications: Hypersensitivity to paracetamol or caffeine, severe hepatic impairment, children under 12.

medicines.dosage: Adults: 250mg to 500mg every 8 hours, or as prescribed by a physician.
medicines.uses: Treatment of bacterial infections including respiratory tract, ear, nose, throat, and skin infections.
medicines.contraindications: History of hypersensitivity to penicillins or cephalosporins, infectious mononucleosis.

medicines.dosage: Adults and adolescents over 12: 1 tablet with water up to 3 times daily after meals. Max 1200mg/day.
medicines.uses: Symptomatic relief of muscular pain, joint pain, backache, headache, fever, and inflammation.
medicines.contraindications: Active gastrointestinal ulceration/bleeding, severe heart failure, severe renal/hepatic impairment, third trimester of pregnancy.

medicines.dosage: Adults and children over 12: 1 tablet (10mg) once daily.
medicines.uses: Relief of nasal and ocular symptoms of seasonal/perennial allergic rhinitis, and chronic idiopathic urticaria (hives).
medicines.contraindications: Severe renal impairment (creatinine clearance < 10 ml/min), hypersensitivity to cetirizine or hydroxyzine.

medicines.dosage: Adults: 1 capsule daily before a meal for 14 days, swallowed whole.
medicines.uses: Treatment of frequent heartburn, gastroesophageal reflux disease (GERD), and gastric/duodenal ulcers.
medicines.contraindications: Hypersensitivity to substituted benzimidazoles, concomitant use with nelfinavir.
